zh.title: 臺灣國籍航空部分歐洲航線飛越俄羅斯領空 交通部表示尊重業者安排
zh.summary: 國籍航空部分歐洲航班近期飛越俄羅斯領空；交通部表示航路尊重業者申請與安排。
body: 臺灣交通部長陳世凱於10月28日表示，國籍航空公司近期飛往部分歐洲航班飛越俄羅斯領空，航路是由航空公司自行申請，交通部與民航局尊重業者的規劃與安排。民航局管理航線主要針對起點與目的地，實際飛航路徑則尊重航空公司的申請。
受到俄烏戰爭影響，多數航空公司過去多選擇避開俄羅斯領空。不過睽違4年後，近期中華航空飛往羅馬的航班，以及長榮航空飛往慕尼黑、巴黎與米蘭的航班，均已飛越俄羅斯領空。陳世凱指出，航空公司會尋找最適切的航路進行飛航，主要考量包括飛航安全與時間成本。

en.title: Taiwanese Carriers Fly Over Russian Airspace on European Routes, Transport Ministry Says
en.summary: Taiwanese carriers recently flew over Russian airspace on European routes; Taiwan's transport ministry respects airline decisions.
body: Taiwan Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih-kai stated on October 28 that Taiwanese airlines recently flew over Russian airspace on select European routes. Chen noted that flight paths are requested independently by the airlines themselves, and the ministry respects their operational arrangements. The Civil Aeronautics Administration manages route origins and destinations, while specific flight paths remain subject to airline applications.

Following the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine war, many airlines had avoided Russian airspace. However, after four years, China Airlines flights to Rome, as well as EVA Air flights to Munich, Paris, and Milan, have recently flown through Russian airspace. Chen added that airlines select optimal flight routes based on comprehensive considerations of safety and time costs.

zh.title: 阿提哈德航空A380首降曼谷蘇凡納布機場(BKK)
zh.summary: 阿提哈德A380首次抵達曼谷蘇凡納布機場；冬季航季啟航新里程
body: 阿提哈德航空於2026年10月26日確認其首架空中巴士A380-800已安全抵達曼谷蘇凡納布機場（BKK），完成自阿布達比扎耶德機場（AUH）約五小時半的飛行，標誌該航司首次將雙層巨無霸飛往泰國。
Flightradar24數據顯示，註冊號A6-APD的11年機齡A380於10月25日當地時間07:20降落曼谷，隨後已返回阿布達比並預計於21:45再次執飛該航線。
阿提哈德早於2026年2月宣佈將阿布達比至曼谷航線改派旗艦A380執行，首席執行官安託納爾多·內維斯表示此舉為「重大里程碑」，並視泰國為重要高端市場，將透過旗艦機型提升運力與旅客體驗。
機艙配置方面，該機型提供「The Residence」三室套房、9間頭等艙私人艙、70席商務艙（位於上層甲板）以及415席經濟艙，經濟艙座寬18.95英寸、可後傾6英寸、腿部空間32英寸。
此次首航配合冬季旅遊旺季啟動，預計將強化阿聯酋、泰國與歐洲之間的連結，並為阿提哈德帶來更多選擇阿聯酋轉機的旅客。

en.title: Etihad Airways Airbus A380 lands in Bangkok for first ever Thailand arrival
en.summary: Etihad A380 arrives in Bangkok, marking first Thailand service for the superjumbo
body: Etihad Airways confirmed on 26 October 2026 that its first Airbus A380‑800 had arrived safely at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) after a five‑and‑a‑half‑hour flight from Abu Dhabi Zayed Airport (AUH), marking the carrier’s inaugural A380 service to Thailand.

Flightradar24 data logged the 11‑year‑old A380, registration A6‑APD, landing in Bangkok on 25 October 2026 at 07:20 local time; the aircraft has since returned to Abu Dhabi and is scheduled to depart again at 21:45.

The airline announced in February 2026 that the Abu Dhabi–Bangkok route would be served by its largest aircraft. Chief Executive Antonoaldo Neves called the arrival a “significant milestone” and highlighted Thailand as a key premium market, saying the flagship jet will increase capacity and deliver Etihad’s most distinctive guest experience.

The cabin features The Residence three‑room suite, nine first‑class private cabins, 70 business‑class seats on the upper deck, and 415 economy seats with 18.95‑inch width, six‑inch recline and 32‑inch legroom.
The launch coincides with the start of the winter travel peak, supporting strong demand between Thailand, the Middle East and Europe and strengthening connectivity through Abu Dhabi.

First class features nine private cabins arranged across a single aisle, each with sliding doors for greater privacy while the upper deck is home to 70 business seats. The A380 accommodates 415 guests in economy, with seats offering an 18.95-inch width, six-inch recline and 32-inch legroom.
